arguments.description: Sincronizzazione completa dei registri schema PostgreSQL con pg_catalog, indipendente dai privilegi di visibilita information_schema del ruolo migratore.
arguments.sql:
INSERT INTO public.schema_tables_registry
(scope,engine,schema_name,table_name,logical_table_key,table_family,purpose_text,data_domain,ownership_scope,storage_scope,lifecycle_status,is_active,is_shared_capable,created_by_migration,metadata_json)
SELECT
    'server','postgresql',pn.nspname,pc.relname,pc.relname,
    CASE
      WHEN pc.relname LIKE 'schema_%' THEN 'schema'
      WHEN pc.relname LIKE 'plugin_%' THEN 'plugin'
      WHEN pc.relname LIKE 'system_%' THEN 'system'
      WHEN pc.relname LIKE 'autsys_%' THEN 'autsys'
      WHEN pc.relname LIKE 'user_%' OR pc.relname IN ('users','organizations') THEN 'user_knowledge'
      ELSE 'operational'
    END,
    'Tabella PostgreSQL reale sincronizzata nel registro schema da AUTSYS PC BRIDGE.',
    'AUTSYS','server','central','active',true,false,
    '20260916_AUTSYS_SCHEMA_REGISTRY_FULL_SYNC_V1',
    jsonb_build_object('registry_sync','pg_catalog','synchronized_at',now())
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class pc
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid=pc.relnamespace
WHERE pn.nspname='public'
  AND pc.relkind IN ('r','p')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_tables_registry r
      WHERE r.engine='postgresql'
        AND r.schema_name=pn.nspname
        AND r.table_name=pc.relname
        AND r.is_active=true
  );

INSERT INTO public.schema_columns_registry
(table_public_id,scope,engine,schema_name,table_name,column_name,logical_column_key,data_type,is_nullable,default_value_text,purpose_text,allowed_values_json,source_hint,retrieval_use,visibility_scope,plugin_read_policy_json,plugin_write_policy_json,relation_hint,lifecycle_status,is_active,created_by_migration,metadata_json)
SELECT
    tr.public_id::text,
    'server','postgresql',pn.nspname,pc.relname,pa.attname,
    pc.relname || '.' || pa.attname,
    pg_catalog.format_type(pa.atttypid,pa.atttypmod),
    NOT pa.attnotnull,
    CASE WHEN pd.oid IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE pg_catalog.pg_get_expr(pd.adbin,pd.adrelid) END,
    'Colonna PostgreSQL reale sincronizzata nel registro schema da AUTSYS PC BRIDGE.',
    '[]'::jsonb,'pg_catalog.pg_attribute','schema_introspection','internal',
    '{}'::jsonb,'{}'::jsonb,NULL,'active',true,
    '20260916_AUTSYS_SCHEMA_REGISTRY_FULL_SYNC_V1',
    jsonb_build_object('attnum',pa.attnum,'type_oid',pa.atttypid)
FROM pg_catalog.pg_class pc
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid=pc.relnamespace
JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attribute pa ON pa.attrelid=pc.oid AND pa.attnum>0 AND NOT pa.attisdropped
LEFT JOIN pg_catalog.pg_attrdef pd ON pd.adrelid=pc.oid AND pd.adnum=pa.attnum
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT r.public_id
    FROM public.schema_tables_registry r
    WHERE r.engine='postgresql'
      AND r.schema_name=pn.nspname
      AND r.table_name=pc.relname
      AND r.is_active=true
    ORDER BY r.id
    LIMIT 1
) tr ON true
WHERE pn.nspname='public'
  AND pc.relkind IN ('r','p')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.schema_columns_registry r
      WHERE r.engine='postgresql'
        AND r.schema_name=pn.nspname
        AND r.table_name=pc.relname
        AND r.column_name=pa.attname
        AND r.is_active=true
  );
